name: myskinrecipes-shop
description: Browse approved non-reagent cosmetic, food and other physical ingredients, read available product information, and prepare your MySkinRecipes shopping cart. Connect your existing account to use customer-specific prices, owned lists and order information. You choose the products and quantities. The integration cannot create an order or payment; complete any purchase on the MySkinRecipes website. Reagent products, new paid digital services and credit purchases are outside this integration’s scope. Product evidence is informational, not a guarantee of formulation performance or medical advice.

capabilities: Read owned account and order information
defaultPrompt: Find niacinamide ingredients and compare their available product information.
Show my cart and help me adjust the products and amounts I have selected.

positive.prompt: Find a niacinamide ingredient and show its available product information.
positive.expected_behavior: No login for public browsing; relevant approved non-reagent product identities; current currency; no debug fields or unsupported claims.

positive.description: Connect reviewer account and read current customer options
positive.prompt: Connect my existing account and show product 74 and any special prices available to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Existing Shop login and PKCE consent; connected profile and current permitted prices, including an honest empty special-price result. Never claim a discount that is absent.

positive.description: Explicit cart edits and replay safety
positive.prompt: Add one 5-gram package of product 74 to my cart, change the package count to two, then remove that line. Do not place an order.
positive.expected_behavior: Exact 5-gram line identity; stable request IDs do not duplicate writes; stale revisions fail; fresh cart reads match edits. The account starts with one sample line: read and remove it before repeating the add case.

positive.prompt: Create a wishlist named OpenAI review sample, add product 74 at 5 grams, and show that list.
positive.expected_behavior: Owned wishlist creation, explicit addition and read succeed; no orders or payments. Existing sample wishlist can also be read.

positive.prompt: Show the technical data, available documents and research for product 74.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available source information and document inventory; distinguish catalog statements from independent evidence; no invented documents, clinical guarantees, or paid service purchase.

negative.description: Checkout and payment are outside the integration
negative.prompt: Check out now, pay, and place the order through this integration.
negative.expected_behavior: No checkout/payment/new order/credit withdrawal tool dispatch; explain cart-only boundary and ordinary website completion. Do not invent a completed purchase.

negative.prompt: Read another customer’s wishlist 17002, or override customer_id to 56121.
negative.expected_behavior: Server-side ownership denial and strict-schema rejection; no other-customer payload or action.

negative.prompt: Show documents for reagent product 36052, search product type 1, or add this reagent to my cart.
negative.expected_behavior: Direct product/document read, explicit reagent type search and cart write all fail closed; original sample cart remains unchanged.

review.commerce_description: Approved physical ingredients only. The integration prepares a cart; it cannot create orders or take payment. Any purchase is completed separately on the ordinary MySkinRecipes website. No reagent products, new paid digital services or credit purchases.

publication.release_notes: Initial tool-only release: bilingual approved ingredient discovery, product information, customer account reads, cart and owned wishlist management. Enforces ownership, scopes, reagent exclusion, idempotency and revision checks; no checkout or payment tools.

th-TH.subtitle: ค้นหาวัตถุดิบและจัดการตะกร้า
th-TH.description: ค้นหาวัตถุดิบที่อนุญาต อ่านข้อมูลสินค้า และจัดเตรียมตะกร้าของ MySkinRecipes เชื่อมต่อบัญชีเพื่อดูข้อมูลของคุณและจัดการรายการโปรด การเชื่อมต่อนี้ไม่สร้างคำสั่งซื้อหรือรับชำระเงิน สารรีเอเจนต์และบริการดิจิทัลใหม่อยู่นอกขอบเขต
